## Answer type

One key's answer, as a load decides it: `envelope` gathers them. A found key may carry several  cuts (in the order a retention reads them: the first decides) and what it searched.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export type Answer<V> = {
    readonly kind: "found";
    readonly value: V;
    readonly cuts?: readonly Cut[];
    readonly coverage?: Coverage;
} | {
    readonly kind: "absent";
    readonly coverage?: Coverage;
} | {
    readonly kind: "unknown";
    readonly reason: LoadReason;
};
```
**References:** [Cut](./hopgraph.cut.md)<!-- -->, [Coverage](./hopgraph.coverage.md)<!-- -->, [LoadReason](./hopgraph.loadreason.md)
